items.title: JJ Johnson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Kai and I did get to team up and form a partnership. It was a partnership in the classic sense that we split up all responsibilities, all income, all everything evenly down the middle.

ctx.x: It went [Baker sings Blow Your Horn].

There you go. There you go. Well, Bennie wasn’t thrilled with Teddy Reig’s proposal of two trombones and didn’t project any interest in it, at which point Teddy Reig, being the free spirit and freewheeling, said, "Well, if we can’t get Bennie Green, we’ll get somebody else. How about Kai Winding?" So it turned out to be Jay and Kai and not J.J. and Bennie Green. We can thank Teddy Reig for all of that.
